paragraphs.text: My final-year project involved building a timetable application for Dublin Bus that predicted delays using 6 months of open GTFS data, constructed in Python with scikit-learn. This project involved tackling a real-world data prediction problem similar in nature to the infrastructure challenges mentioned at Stripe.

I have experience in multi-person projects, such as my internship at Harbour Payments where I built an internal TypeScript and React dashboard for agents to check failed card payments. During that time, I also improved the unit test coverage on the refunds service from 41% to 68% and wrote PostgreSQL queries to identify duplicate refunds that the finance team reviewed weekly. These tasks required operating within existing codebases and receiving feedback.

Furthermore, I possess a strong technical background, holding a BSc in Computer Science from University College Dublin. I am proficient in Python, TypeScript, React, SQL, and Git. My experience as an events officer for the university's computer society also involved running 12 workshops in one year for student groups of 30 to 80 people each.
I haven't yet used AI tools while applying critical judgment to validate outputs, but I am ready to learn this. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills fit with your team.
